local_exhibit: skills-evals ADR 0002 decision 4: operator login, not badge input

description.original: Triage a large list of items (release-note bullets, issues, alerts, findings; dozens to thousands) against one or more repos by fanning the work out to parallel subagents, without letting ID drift or a thin inventory corrupt the result. Use when asked to go through a changelog, backlog or report and decide which items affect your code, especially if you are about to split the list across agents. Not for a list you can read in one sitting, or for reviewing one dependency bump.
